description: This file defines the SugarRelationshipFactory class responsible for creating and managing relationship objects within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM framework. It includes methods for loading, caching, and retrieving relationship definitions, as well as dynamically including specific relationship classes based on relationship types.

classes.name: SugarRelationshipFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating and managing relationship objects in SuiteCRM/SugarCRM, including caching and dynamic class loading based on relationship types.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the factory.

methods.name: deleteCache
methods.description: Deletes the cached relationship data file.

methods.name: getRelationship
methods.description: Retrieves a relationship object by name, instantiating the appropriate class based on relationship type.

methods.name: getRelationshipDef
methods.description: Returns the relationship definition array for a given relationship name.

methods.name: loadRelationships
methods.description: Loads relationship definitions from cache or builds cache if not available.

methods.name: buildRelationshipCache
methods.description: Builds and caches the relationship definitions from module vardefs and the dictionary.

methods.name: getCacheFile
methods.description: Returns the filepath for the cached relationships.
